EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
You’re invited to join a unique discussion between thought leaders from Flywire and Nystedt Enterprise Solutions for a discussion about payments, treasury and risk management.
Register to join us on Tuesday, November 1st at 1pm ET for the virtual discussion:
Worth the risk? How to think strategically about risk management and receivables <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/worth-the-risk-online-webinar]]>
About our speakers
Johan Nystedt Prior to founding NES, Johan was the SVP Finance for RR Donnelley where he headed up M&A, Investor Relations and corporate FP&A. Prior to that, Johan was the Chief Risk Officer, Treasurer and head of Investor Relations at Conagra Brands. Johan has held senior Treasury, Investor Relations and M&A roles at Levi Strauss, Kraft Foods and Altria Group. At NES Johan provides advisory and technological services to Enterprise Risk Management clients
Greg Leven Greg joined Flywire as SVP of B2B Sales with 15 years of experience in the global payments and enterprise software space. Prior to Flywire, Greg was the Global Head of Coupa Pay at Coupa Software where his solution helped organizations automate the Procure to Pay function. He has held VP roles at Mastercard and StoneX Group. Greg specializes in helping global organizations unlock value from their existing payment and collection processes.
Register today <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/worth-the-risk-online-webinar]]>
We hope to see you there!
Flywire for B2B
